title: 第 28 章 沈长老竟要收他为徒
novel_title: 我被师姐凌辱，你说我罪恶滔天？
content_zh:
雷电击中陆云的瞬间整个擂台都被白光吞没了，那光芒太刺眼了台下的弟子们纷纷抬手挡住了眼睛。

    等光芒散去之后所有人都看到了擂台上的画面，只见陆云躺在擂台中央整个人已经昏死了过去。

    而且衣服也被雷电烧焦了一大片露出来的皮肤上全是焦黑的伤痕，嘴角挂着血迹脸色苍白得像是死了一样。

    “陆师兄。”

    “天呐陈默这一招也太狠了吧，陆师兄该不会死了吧。”

    台下的弟子们惊呼声响起，每个人的脸上都写满了震惊。

    金丹大圆满的陆云服用了爆元丹强行提升到元婴期，结果还是被陈默一招打成了这样。

    这个陈默到底有多强啊，台下的弟子们看着陈默的眼神都变了起来。

    只见陆瑶站在人群中整个人都傻眼了，她的嘴巴张得大大的眼睛瞪得像是见了鬼一样。

    “不可能，这不可能……”陆瑶喃喃自语的说道。

    要知道她哥服用了爆元丹拥有元婴期的实力，怎么可能会输给陈默那个废物，陆瑶的脑子一片空白完全无法接受眼前这个事实。

    “哥。”陆瑶尖叫了一声然后朝擂台冲了过去，她的声音都在颤抖。

    随后她扑到陆云身边蹲下来查看他的伤势，陆云的眼睛紧闭着呼吸很微弱。

    “哥你醒醒，你别吓我。”陆瑶的声音里有几分哭腔。

    可陆云没有任何反应他昏得很沉，身上的伤口还在往外流血。

    抬起头以后她看着陈默眼中全是恨意，那眼神像是要把陈默生吞活剥了一样。

    “陈默你把我哥伤成这样，我不会放过你的。”陆瑶说道。

    然而陈默看了她一眼脸上没有什么表情，他没有说话转身朝擂台边缘走去。

    此刻的周玄站在台下整个人都愣住了，他的嘴巴张得大大的半天说不出一个字来。

    没想到陈默居然赢了，他居然打赢了服用爆元丹的陆云。

    只见周玄的腿都在发抖，此刻他在心里想着陈默真的太强了。

    “陈默你太厉害了。”周玄喊道。

    而陈默这时却摆了摆手，此刻周玄根本控制不住自己脸上的笑容而且怎么都压不下去。

    高台之上沈长老坐在椅子上看着陈默，她的眼中闪过一丝惊讶。

    “这个外门弟子的雷法有些实力啊。”沈长老开口说道。

    “圆满级别的上品雷法，在外门能学到这种东西倒是稀奇。”

    当鹤阳真人听到这句话之后连忙点头，他在心里想着沈长老居然对陈默感兴趣。

    “这个弟子叫陈默，是外门最近才冒出来的。”鹤阳真人说道。

    “之前一直不显山露水，最近不知道得了什么机缘修为暴涨。”
content_en:
The moment the lightning struck Lu Yun, the entire arena was engulfed in white light. The light was so dazzling that the disciples in the audience raised their hands to cover their eyes.

    After the light dissipated, everyone saw the scene on the ring. They saw Lu Yun lying in the middle of the ring, unconscious.

    Moreover, his clothes were scorched by lightning, and a large area of ​​exposed skin was covered with scorched black scars. There was blood on the corner of his mouth, and his face was as pale as death.

    "Senior Brother Lu."

    "Oh my god, Chen Mo's move was too cruel. Is Senior Brother Lu dead?"

    The disciples in the audience screamed in surprise, and everyone's face was full of shock.

    Lu Yun, who had perfected the golden elixir, took the Baoyuan Dan and was forced to advance to the Nascent Soul stage, but was still beaten like this by Chen Mo.

    How strong is this Chen Mo? The eyes of the disciples in the audience changed when they looked at Chen Mo.

    I saw Lu Yao standing in the crowd, dumbfounded, her mouth wide open and her eyes wide open as if she had seen a ghost.

    "Impossible, this is impossible..." Lu Yao muttered to herself.

    To know how her brother could lose to Chen Mo, a loser who had taken Yuan Yuan Dan and had the strength of the Nascent Soul stage, Lu Yao's mind went blank and she couldn't accept the fact in front of her.

    "Brother." Lu Yao screamed and rushed towards the ring, her voice trembling.

    Then she rushed to Lu Yun and squatted down to check his injuries. Lu Yun's eyes were closed tightly and his breathing was weak.

    "Brother, wake up, don't scare me." Lu Yao's voice was a bit crying.

    But Lu Yun didn't respond. He was very unconscious and the wounds on his body were still bleeding.

    After raising her head, she looked at Chen Mo with eyes full of hatred, as if he wanted to eat Chen Mo alive.

    "Chen Mo, you hurt my brother like this, I won't let you go." Lu Yao said.

    However, Chen Mo glanced at her with no expression on his face. He turned around and walked towards the edge of the ring without saying a word.

    At this moment, Zhou Xuan stood in the audience and was completely stunned. His mouth was wide open and he couldn't say a word for a long time.

    Unexpectedly, Chen Mo actually won. He actually defeated Lu Yun who took the Baoyuan Dan.

    Zhou Xuan's legs were trembling. At this moment, he was thinking that Chen Mo was really too strong.

    "Chen Mo, you are so awesome." Zhou Xuan shouted.

    But Chen Mo waved his hand at this moment. At this moment, Zhou Xuan couldn't control the smile on his face at all and couldn't suppress it no matter what.

    Elder Shen sat on a chair on the high platform and looked at Chen Mo, a trace of surprise flashed in her eyes.

    "This outer disciple's thunder method is quite powerful." Elder Shen said.

    "It's unusual to learn such a thing from the outer sect of a high-grade lightning technique at the perfection level."

    When Master Heyang nodded quickly after hearing this, he was thinking that Elder Shen was actually interested in Chen Mo.

    "This disciple's name is Chen Mo. He just appeared from the outer sect recently." Master Heyang said.

    "I have always been quiet before, but I don't know what chance I got recently and my cultivation level has skyrocketed."
title_en: Chapter 28 Elder Shen actually wants to accept him as his disciple
